title: Preserving Pretrained CFG Structure in RL for Diffusion Models with Conditional Contrast Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27288v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important component in the post-training of diffusion models. In practice, however, standard RL often improves the target reward without reliably preserving holistic generation quality, leading to unstable reward-quality trade-offs that we view as a form of reward hacking. Since Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is known to improve visual clarity, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality in generation, we investigate whether its underlying structure can serve as a useful prior during RL. We present a unified geometric view that interprets both CFG and RL as correction vectors in a common prediction space, and identify the projection of the RL-induced correction onto the pretrained CFG correction as a useful diagnostic of quality-related structural preservation. translated_title: 基于条件对比正则化在扩散模型强化学习中保留预训练CFG结构
translated_abstract: 强化学习已成为扩散模型后训练的重要组成部分。然而在实践中，标准强化学习往往能够提升目标奖励，却无法可靠地保持整体生成质量，导致不稳定的奖励-质量权衡，我们认为这是奖励黑客行为的一种表现形式。由于无分类器引导在提升生成图像的视觉清晰度、提示词对齐和感知质量方面的作用已为人所知，我们研究其底层结构能否在强化学习过程中作为有用的先验。我们提出了一个统一的几何视角，将CFG和RL都解释为同一预测空间中的校正向量，并将RL引起的校正向量在预训练CFG校正方向上的投影确定为衡量质量相关结构保留程度的有效诊断指标。几何分析和旋转干预实验进一步表明，预训练的CFG方向携带着对生成质量有用的信息。
tldr: 提出条件对比正则化方法，在扩散模型强化学习后训练中保留预训练CFG的几何结构，作为诊断奖励黑客行为的有效指标，从而实现奖励提升与整体生成质量之间更稳定的权衡。
